source_caption:
📺 Mom (2013–2021)

Mom follows Christy Plunkett, a single mother working to rebuild her life after struggling with addiction and making difficult choices in her past. Determined to stay sober and create a better future for her family, Christy faces unexpected challenges when her outspoken and unpredictable mother, Bonnie, reenters her life. Despite their complicated relationship and years of disagreements, the two women gradually learn to support each other while navigating friendships, romantic relationships, financial struggles, and everyday family drama. Alongside a close group of friends from their recovery meetings, Christy and Bonnie discover that personal growth often comes with setbacks, laughter, and second chances. Combining hilarious comedy, heartfelt moments, and emotional storytelling, the series explores motherhood, forgiveness, friendship, recovery, and the importance of family.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~22 minutes per episode • 8 seasons • 170 episodes

🎥 Creators: Chuck Lorre, Eddie Gorodetsky, and Gemma Baker

🏆 Recognition: Starring Anna Faris and Allison Janney, the series received widespread praise for balancing humor with serious real-life issues. Allison Janney won two Primetime Emmy Awards for her performance as Bonnie Plunkett.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Paramount+, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Mom is an American television sitcom created by Chuck Lorre, Eddie Gorodetsky, and Gemma Baker that aired for eight seasons on CBS from September 23, 2013, to May 13, 2021. Set in Napa, California, it follows dysfunctional mother/daughter duo Bonnie and Christy Plunkett, who, after having been estranged for years while both struggled with addiction, attempt to pull their lives together by trying to stay sober. It stars Anna Faris and Allison Janney, with Mimi Kennedy, Jaime Pressly, Beth Hall, William Fichtner, Sadie Calvano, Blake Garrett Rosenthal, Matt Jones, French Stewart and Kristen Johnston in supporting roles.
